causal_availability.decision_boundary: ceil raw_available to the next 5m UTC boundary
forbidden_inputs: current or future row in normalization

control_construction.block_controls: reuse the primary 26208-valid-height midrank, +/-0.90 tails, six-confirmation availability, onset, and 864-bar non-overlap unless the named transform changes a field

daily_aggregate_shadow.availability: D+2 00:00 UTC plus one complete 5m latency bar
daily_aggregate_shadow.cadence_compression: median of block-level cadence_compression over the completed source day
daily_aggregate_shadow.fee_pressure: log1p(sum(total_fees[h-100])) over the completed source day
daily_aggregate_shadow.normalization: strict-prior empirical midrank over exactly 180 valid source days
daily_aggregate_shadow.onset_and_nonoverlap: same valid-state onset and 864-bar chronological non-overlap as primary
daily_aggregate_shadow.source_day: UTC day of timestamp[h] for valid exact-maturity height h
daily_aggregate_shadow.states: same joint 0.90/0.10 tails and side orientation as primary

control_construction.exposure_correlation: Pearson correlation of signed 5m position exposure; zero when either vector has zero variance

random_clock.candidate_lattice: valid normalized maturity heights not used by the primary clock
random_clock.matching: preserve exact primary count in every stratum and enforce 864-bar non-overlap globally
random_clock.strata: entry calendar year, entry calendar month, primary side, and cadence-rank quartile

control_construction.stale_7d: for each h, use ranks from the latest valid maturity height with timestamp<=timestamp[h]-604800; retain h availability

controls.cadence_only: cadence-rank tail onset with the primary side orientation, availability, hold, and non-overlap
controls.constant_long_same_clock: same primary entry/exit clock with side fixed to long
controls.constant_short_same_clock: same primary entry/exit clock with side fixed to short
controls.daily_aggregate_shadow: aggregate the exact block primitives by completed UTC maturation day and enter only at D+2 00:05 UTC
controls.direction_flip: same primary entry/exit clock with every side multiplied by -1; diagnostic only
controls.fee_only: fee-rank tail onset with the primary side orientation, availability, hold, and non-overlap
controls.one_bar_delayed_entry: same primary signals and sides; shift entry and scheduled exit exactly one 5m bar later
controls.origin_day_shift_leakage_sentinel: assigning the signal to h-100 or its UTC day is prohibited and must be reported as a leakage sentinel only
controls.pseudo_maturity_101: replace the exact origin by h-101 and elapsed span by 101 blocks
controls.pseudo_maturity_99: replace the exact origin by h-99 and elapsed span by 99 blocks
controls.same_height_fee: replace total_fees[h-100] by total_fees[h]; retain exact primary cadence and scheduling
controls.stale_7d: at height h use the latest already observed feature pair at or before timestamp[h]-604800 seconds
controls.year_month_side_activity_stratified_rand: sample non-overlapping source times preserving year, month, side, event count, and source-activity stratum; seed 20260720

eligibility.onset: current valid state is extreme and differs from the immediately preceding valid state; invalid heights retain but cannot change prior state
eligibility.ordering: increasing maturity height, then chronological non-overlap
eligibility.suppression: accept the earliest onset with entry_time>=prior accepted exit_time; never replace a suppressed onset

event_support_gates.long_short_share_train_and_selection: each side between 25% and 75% inclusive in each window

execution.funding: exact funding, entry-inclusive/exit-exclusive, fixed entry quantity

normalization.cadence_rank: midrank of cadence_compression over the last 26208 valid maturity heights strictly below h
normalization.fee_rank: midrank of fee_pressure over the last 26208 valid maturity heights strictly below h

selection_stages.stage_2: open 2023 only after exact train pass

source_features.valid_height: all required heights exist, total_fees[h-100]>=0, and maturity_elapsed_seconds>0

source_novelty_gates.exposure_grid: 5m UTC over 2021-01-01 inclusive through 2024-01-01 exclusive; flat=0
source_novelty_gates.failure_action: reject before loading market or funding outcomes; no threshold, lag, side, onset, or hold repair
feature_pairs: primary extreme state versus pseudo-maturity-99 extreme state
primary extreme state versus pseudo-maturity-101 extreme state

strict_accounting.cagr_clock: full declared wall-clock window including idle cash
strict_accounting.cluster_test: one-sided weekly entry-cluster sign flip; 100000 draws; seed 20260720
strict_accounting.costs: entry, scheduled exit, and hypothetical adverse liquidation costs included
strict_accounting.held_path_order: all favorable OHLC/funding-credit extremes before all adverse OHLC/funding-debit extremes
